notes: TBox expansion, paired with people-replace-0020. Keeps the revision's relation (has_minimum_age) and new conclusion (at least 40 years old) and gives it to a made-up office, Mayor of the town of Vessarby, under the real class of mayors, so no old value is pushed out. The derived queries name invented mayors with the office stated in the prompt (inheritance, 2 hops, bridge in the prompt): the inserted rule is their only route to the age. The near unrelated query asks the real minimum age for a President of the United States, which must stay 35; a method that learned a bare 'office-holder must be 40' mapping would leak there. Town and mayor names are invented; the counting step records that they are absent from the corpus. Side facts and checks are those of the paired revision.
